extracted.intended_audience: research mathematicians working on Mochizuki's IUT / arithmetic geometry specialists
extracted.subtask_description: Definitions and structural requirements for (cid:2)-Hodge theatres, D-/F-/F'-prime-strips, their local/global realisations, reconstruction algorithms, and compatibility (links, Kummer structures) used in inter-universal Teichmüller theory.

rubrics_metrics.name: (cid:2)-Hodge theatre
rubrics_metrics.description: A (cid:2)-Hodge theatre is a collection yHT (cid:2) = (fyF_v gv2V; yF(cid:13)_mod) where (1) (local object) yF_v is a pre-Frobenioid (resp. a triple (yC_v; yD_v; y(cid:20)_v)) isomorphic to the model F_v in Definition 10.2 for v in Vnon (resp. v in Varc); (2) (global realised object with localisations) yF(cid:13)_mod is a quadruple (yC'_mod; Prime(yC(cid:13)_mod) -> V; fyF'_v gv2V; fy((cid:26))_v gv2V) such that yC'_mod is equivalent to the model C'_mod and the local components reconstruct to the model objects.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes algorithmic reconstruction conditions: objects yDv, yD'v, etc., correspond to the model objects without 'y' and must be isomorphic to the algorithmically reconstructed model triples. There must exist isomorphisms gl: to loc: (cid:24)(cid:0)! (cid:8)R yC'_v sending the global data to local model C'_v (cf. text around Definition 10.7).

rubrics_metrics.name: (cid:2)-link (full poly-isomorphism)
rubrics_metrics.description: A (cid:2)-link from yHT (cid:2) to zHT (cid:2) is the full poly-isomorphism (the full poly-isomorphism is non-empty) and is written as yHT (cid:2) (cid:2)(cid:0)! zHT (cid:2).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The (cid:2)-link (the Frobenius-picture) is the diagram implementing the full poly-isomorphism; essential meaning includes multiplicative relations (e.g., ' (cid:2)N ... q^N ... ' for v in Vbad). The link preserves some structures (see Preservation of D' and O(cid:2) below) but not all (value-group, holomorphic base portions may not be shared).

rubrics_metrics.name: Preservation of D' under (cid:2)-link
rubrics_metrics.description: For each v in V, the composite full poly-isomorphism yD'_v ! yD_v full poly (cid:24)(cid:0)! zD'_v preserves the mono-analytic base D' (i.e., the mono-analytic base \D'v is 'horizontally shared' under the (cid:2)-link).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: First isomorphism is tautological for v in Vgood and induced by explicit maps for v in Vbad; holomorphic base 'Dv' is not shared under the (cid:2)-link. The link shares underlying mono-analytic base structures but not arithmetically holomorphic base structures.

rubrics_metrics.name: Preservation of O(cid:2) under (cid:2)-link
rubrics_metrics.description: For each v in V the composite full poly-isomorphism O(cid:2)_yC'_v ! O(cid:2)_yC_v full poly (cid:24)(cid:0)! O(cid:2)_zC'_v preserves the mono-analytic O(cid:2) data (\O(cid:2) is horizontally shared under the (cid:2)-link).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The first isomorphism is tautological for v in Vgood and induced by explicit maps for v in Vbad; the value-group portion is not shared under the (cid:2)-link.

rubrics_metrics.name: D-prime-strip (holomorphic base)
rubrics_metrics.description: A D-prime-strip yD = fyD_v gv2V is a collection such that yD_v is a category equivalent to the model D_v for v in Vnon, and yD_v is an Aut-holomorphic orbispace isomorphic to the model D_v for v in Varc. A morphism of D-prime-strips is a collection of morphisms indexed by V.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This is the holomorphic base-prime-strip notion (Definition 10.9 (1)).

rubrics_metrics.name: D'-prime-strip (mono-analytic base)
rubrics_metrics.description: A D'-prime-strip yD' = fyD'_v gv2V is a collection such that yD'_v is a category equivalent to the model D'_v in Definition 10.2 (2) for v in Vnon, and yD'_v is a split monoid isomorphic to the model D'_v for v in Vbad/Varc as appropriate. Morphisms are collections indexed by V.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This is the mono-analytic base-prime-strip notion (Definition 10.9 (2)).

rubrics_metrics.name: F-prime-strip (holomorphic Frobenioid-theoretic)
rubrics_metrics.description: An F-prime-strip yF = fyF_v gv2V is a collection such that yF_v is a pre-Frobenioid isomorphic to the model C_v for v in Vnon, and yF_v = (yC_v; yD_v; y(cid:20)_v) is a triple (category, Aut-holomorphic orbispace, Kummer structure) isomorphic to the model F_v for v in Varc. Isomorphisms are collections indexed by V.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Definition 10.9 (3). The isomorphism classes must match the model local objects described earlier.

rubrics_metrics.name: F'-prime-strip (mono-analytic Frobenioid-theoretic)
rubrics_metrics.description: An F'-prime-strip yF' = fyF'_v gv2V is a collection where for v in Vbad yF'_v is a (cid:22)2l-split pre-Frobenioid, for v in Vgood\Vnon it is a split pre-Frobenioid, and for v in Varc it is a triple (yC'_v; yspl'_v; yD'_v) isomorphic to the model F'_v. Morphisms/indexed isomorphisms are collections over V.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Definition 10.9 (4). Components must be isomorphic to the model F' local structures; includes explicit splittings where required.

rubrics_metrics.name: F(cid:13)-prime-strip (global realised with localisations)
rubrics_metrics.description: A F(cid:13)-prime-strip yF(cid:13) is a quadruple (yC(cid:13); Prime(yC(cid:13)) -> V; yF'; fy((cid:26))_v gv2V) where yC(cid:13) is a pre-Frobenioid equivalent to the model C'_mod, Prime gives a bijection to primes V, yF' is an F'-prime-strip, and the local-to-global isomorphisms (gl: to loc:) to the reconstructed local C'_v exist.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Definition 10.9 (5). Isomorphisms of such quadruples are collections indexed by V. Used to compute global log-volumes via local data.

rubrics_metrics.name: Bijectivity of isomorphism maps (Lemma 10.10 (1)-(3))
rubrics_metrics.description: Natural maps Isom(1F~, 2F~) -> Isom(Base(1F~), Base(2F~)) and similar for other model/non-realised Frobenioids are bijective; likewise IsomF(1F,2F) -> IsomD(1D,2D) and IsomF'(1F',2F') -> IsomD'(1D',2D') are bijective.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This asserts that for the listed classes, isomorphisms of Frobenioids (or prime-strips) are completely determined by isomorphisms of their base (D-)structures (Lemma 10.10 (1)-(3)). Useful as a reconstruction/isomorphism criterion.

rubrics_metrics.name: Automorphism bijectivity for tempered Frobenioids (Lemma 10.10 (4))
rubrics_metrics.description: For v in Vbad, if F_v is the tempered Frobenioid (example 8.8) whose base category is D_v, then the natural map Aut(F_v) -> Aut(D_v) is bijective.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Automorphisms of the tempered Frobenioid arise from automorphisms of D_v by Theorem 3.17; the injectivity argument uses cyclotomic rigidity and Kummer naturality to show identity on rational functions and divisor monoids.

rubrics_metrics.name: Isomorphisms of Hodge theatres determined by D-prime-strips (Lemma 10.10 (5))
rubrics_metrics.description: For T h-Hodge theatres 1HT(2), 2HT(2) with associated D-prime-strips 1D>, 2D>, the natural map Isom(1HT(2),2HT(2)) -> IsomD(1D>,2D>) is bijective.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Isomorphisms of full Hodge theatre structures are controlled by the underlying D-prime-strip isomorphisms.

rubrics_metrics.name: Lifting morphisms from D-prime-strips to F-prime-strips (Remark 10.10.1)
rubrics_metrics.description: Given a morphism tau: 1D -> 2D of D-prime-strips such that all v in Vgood components are isomorphisms and induced map tau': 1D' -> 2D' is an isomorphism, there exists a unique lift ' : 1F -> 2F of F-prime-strips lying over tau.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Construct the pull-back (fiber product) of the pre-Frobenioids via v-components of tau to get (tau)^{*}(2F) whose associated D-prime-strip equals 1D; the tautological equality lifts uniquely by Lemma 10.10 (2).

rubrics_metrics.name: Group-theoretic reconstruction of valuations and Aut-holomorphic orbispaces (Definition 10.11 (1))
rubrics_metrics.description: From a global object yD} (or yD}(cid:6)) one can group-theoretically reconstruct a set V(yD}) of valuations corresponding to V(K). For w in V(yD})_{arc} one can reconstruct an Aut-holomorphic orbispace C(yD}; w) corresponding to C_w (and similarly X(yD}(cid:6); w) ). Morphisms U -> yD} correspond to morphisms of Aut-holomorphic orbispaces U -> C(yD}; w) for some w.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Procedure: reconstruct (cid:25)^1(yD}(cid:6)) field, then valuations, take orbits, etc. (References: Proposition 4.8, Lemma 4.9 and Example 9.5).

rubrics_metrics.name: Poly-morphism notion for D-prime-strips and capsules (Definition 10.11 (2)-(3))
rubrics_metrics.description: A poly-morphism yD_poly(cid:0)! yD} (or to yD}(cid:6)) is a collection of poly-morphisms f_yD_v indexed by v in V (for v in Vnon use Definition 6.1 (5), for Varc use the above reconstruction). For a capsule E_D = {eD_e} a poly-morphism ED_poly(cid:0)! yD} is a collection of poly-morphisms feD_e_poly(cid:0)! yD indexed by e in E.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Poly-morphisms are defined componentwise; capsules supply families of components to map in.

rubrics_metrics.name: Construction of O?(A1), OI(A1) and OI(2)(22)(A1) from an F'-prime-strip (Definition 10.12 (1))
rubrics_metrics.description: For zF' = {zF'_v}_v, for each v take a universal covering pro-object zA1 of zD'_v and zG := Aut(zA1). For v in Vbad (resp. v in Vgood\Vnon) define O?(zA1) as the submonoid generated by (cid:22)2l(zA1) and image of splittings (resp. determined by image of splittings); set OI(zA1) := O?(zA1)/(cid:22)2l(zA1) (resp. OI(zA1) := O?(zA1)). Then define OI(cid:2)(cid:22)(zA1) := OI(zA1) (cid:2)O(cid:2)(cid:22)(zA1), equipped with natural zG-actions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This constructs the monoidal data used to recover rational-function monoids and divisor monoids; zG-actions are crucial for reconstruction (Definition 10.12).

rubrics_metrics.name: Existence of unique bZ(cid:2)-orbit of isomorphisms and Isomet-orbit (Definition 10.12 (1))
rubrics_metrics.description: For v in Vnon one can reconstruct ind-topological modules zG ⋉ O(cid:2)(zG), zG ⋉ O(cid:2)(cid:22)(zG) with zG-action and there exists a unique bZ(cid:2)-orbit of isomorphisms z(cid:20)'(cid:2)_v: O(cid:2)(zG) -> O(cid:2)(zA1) and an Isomet-orbit z(cid:20)'(cid:2)(cid:22)_v: O(cid:2)(cid:22)(zG) -> O(cid:2)(cid:22)(zA1).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: These orbits induce the (cid:2)(cid:22)-Kummer structure on the model Frobenioid and determine split-(cid:2)(cid:22)-Kummer pre-Frobenioids zF'I(cid:2)(cid:22)_v for v in Vnon (Definition 8.5 references).

rubrics_metrics.name: Definition of zF'I(cid:2)(cid:22) and global assemblies (Definition 10.12 (2)-(4))
rubrics_metrics.description: Assemble local split-(cid:2)(cid:22)-Kummer pre-Frobenioids zF'I(cid:2)(cid:22)_v over v in V into zF'I(cid:2)(cid:22) = {zF'I(cid:2)(cid:22)_v}_v. Define variants zF'(cid:2), zF'(cid:2)(cid:22) by replacing split pre-Frobenioids with split Frobenioids with trivial splittings (units). An F'(cid:2)-prime-strip (and analogous F'(cid:2)(cid:22), F'I(cid:2)(cid:22)) is a collection isomorphic to these models at each v. An F(cid:13)I(cid:2)(cid:22)-prime-strip is the corresponding global quadruple with Prime map and local gl:isomorphisms.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: These global assemblies require isomorphisms of topological monoids gl: to loc: at each prime to the reconstructed C'_v objects (Definition 10.12 (4)).

rubrics_metrics.name: Handling Archimedean valuations and torsion (Remark 10.12.1)
rubrics_metrics.description: For v in Varc, because the Archimedean logarithm does not kill torsion, replace parts of log-link by k(...)_gp = (cid:22)^N(k) and regard k as reconstructed from (O(cid:3)_k)_gp/(cid:22)^N(k) rather than from (O(cid:3)_k)_gp; assign weight N on corresponding log-volume.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use inductive systems and weight tagging for Archimedean components to preserve the crucial non-interference properties (see references to Section 5.2 and later propositions).

rubrics_metrics.name: Submonoids O? and OI and F'? / F'I constructions (Definition 10.13)
rubrics_metrics.description: For each w in Vbad the splittings of the (cid:22)2l-split-Frobenioid determine submonoids O?((cid:0)) subset O(cid:3)((cid:0)) and quotients OI((cid:0)) = O?((cid:0))/O(cid:22)((cid:0)). For w in Vgood the splitting determines a submonoid O?((cid:0)). Replacing the (cid:22)2l-split/split Frobenioid portions by the pre-Frobenioids from these subquotient monoids yields zF'? and zF'I collections and hence F(cid:13)? and F(cid:13)I prime-strips.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Definition 10.13 formalises partial-quotient (sub)monoid constructions yielding '?', 'I' variants of prime-strips; isomorphisms are again collections indexed by V.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reconstruction of tempered/profinite groups and canonical LabCusp labels (Definition 10.14 (1)-(2))
rubrics_metrics.description: From yD_v (component of a D-prime-strip) one functorially reconstructs a tempered group ((cid:27)(cid:25)^1(yD_v)) for v in Vbad and a profinite group for v in Vgood\Vnon corresponding to C_v; for v in Varc reconstruct an Aut-holomorphic orbispace yD_v. The set of label classes of cusps LabCusp(yD_v) (each label class consists of two cusps) has a natural F_l-torsor structure and there is a canonical element y(cid:17)_v corresponding to initial data.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reconstruction references: Lemma 7.12, Lemma 7.25, Corollary 6.12, Corollary 2.9, and Lemma 7.16. LabCusp(yD) assembled over v gives a global F_l-torsor.

rubrics_metrics.name: Canonical bijections of LabCusp across primes (Proposition 10.15)
rubrics_metrics.description: For any v,w in V there exist unique bijections LabCusp(yD_v) -> LabCusp(yD_w) compatible with the F_l-torsor structures and sending canonical elements y(cid:17)_v to y(cid:17)_w; these identifications allow writing LabCusp(yD) with a canonical element.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This yields a natural bijection LabCusp(yD) -> F_l (the F_l-torsor trivialises via canonical elements).

rubrics_metrics.name: Model D-NF-Bridge construction and NF poly-morphism (Definition 10.16)
rubrics_metrics.description: Define Aut(cid:15)(C K), Aut(C K) etc and reconstruct Out(...) = Aut(D}) subgroups; there is a natural homomorphism Out((cid:5)CK) -> Aut((cid:1)ab_X(cid:10)Fl)/{(cid:6)1} leading to images identified with subgroups of GL2(Fl)/{(cid:6)1}. Define V_un, V_Bor, VBor, etc and the natural isomorphism Aut(C K)/Aut(cid:15)(C K) -> F_l. For each v produce poly-morphisms (cid:30)_NF_v : D_v -> D} and by action of j in F_l produce Dj poly-morphisms, assembling D> = {Dj}_{j in F_l} with poly-morphisms D> -> D}.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This provides the NF-bridge/poly-morphism machinery: use group-theoretic reconstruction of X from (cid:5)CK and obtain poly-morphisms stable under Aut(cid:15)(D}). The action of F_l yields a family of poly-morphisms indexed by j in F_l.
